register.labelZh: APPEAL 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: 慈善機構、學校、醫院或公共機構需要援助、捐款、義工或行動時,可以使用 appeal for。；appeal to 可以描述哪些書籍、課程、工作、產品或活動對某一群人具有吸引力。；要求別人採取行動時,可以訴諸對方的善意、公平意識、常識或責任感。；這些表達常見於新聞報道、公共訊息、慈善活動、廣告和評論。
register.summaryEn: Appeal for can be used when charities, schools, hospitals or public organisations urgently request help, money, volunteers or action. Appeal to can describe the books, courses, jobs, products or activities that interest a particular group. You can appeal to someone’s kindness, fairness, common sense or sense of responsibility when asking that person to act. These expressions often appear in news reports, public messages, charity campaigns, advertisements and reviews.
